sections: A name separated from historical hengshanensis sequences
与历史 hengshanensis 序列分开的名称

The 2025 study assigns fifteen specimens and the earlier 2021 hengshanensis-labelled molecular clade to newly described gutu after comparison with historical hengshanensis types. The old sequence label cannot be carried into the revised hengshanensis concept without voucher reconciliation.
2025 年研究与历史 hengshanensis 模式比较后，将十五件标本及早前 2021 年标 hengshanensis 的分子支系分配给新描述 gutu。未经凭证协调，旧序列标签不能直接带入修订 hengshanensis 概念。
Fifteen types support a limited diagnostic series
十五件模式支持有限诊断系列

The type series has seven males, including the holotype, and eight females. The diagnosis combines relatively smooth dorsal skin, weak vomerine ridges without teeth, narrow toe fringes, heels meeting in the stated posture, thickened supratympanic folds, small inner metatarsal tubercles and dark ventrolateral patches. These are sample-scoped observations, not population-wide size extrema or a complete key.
模式系列包括正模在内七雄、八雌。诊断组合为较光滑背皮、弱犁骨棱而无齿、窄趾缘、指定姿势下踵相接、增厚鼓上褶、小内跖瘤及暗腹侧斑。这些观察受样本限制，不是种群整体体型极值或完整检索表。
Calling months differ between source sections
来源不同章节的鸣叫月份不同

Ecology reports stream-side montane forest at about 250–1100 m and calls April–July. Discussion gives early May–late July and suggests seasonal separation from hengshanensis as one possible prezygotic factor. Both statements remain attributed; no eggs, full breeding chronology or direct reproductive-isolation experiment follows from calling observations.
生态段报告约250–1100米山地林溪边及四月至七月鸣声；讨论给五月上旬至七月下旬，提出与 hengshanensis 季节分离可能是合子前因素之一。两种说法均保留归属，鸣声观察不能提供卵、完整繁殖时序或直接繁殖隔离实验。
